root_cause.summary: services/governance/record_store.py replaced the previous ordinary temporary-file write with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile, which creates a 0600-mode file. os.replace publishes that inode (including its restrictive mode) as the canonical record file with no mode restoration, so a readonly consumer running under a distinct UID loses read access it previously had at 0644/umask-derived modes.

source_fix_ownership.note: Parent task implemented the corrective fix in services/governance/record_store.py, eliminating the process-global umask race by creating files with os.open(O_CREAT | O_EXCL, mode=0o666) letting kernel umask apply, and ordering fchmod on open fd before file durability fsync, atomic replace, and directory fsync.

initial_pr_state_at_diagnosis.conclusion: At initial check, PR #5709 was stranded at head d4d961804 with Persona provisioning owner contracts failing due to 0600 file-mode regression.

independent_final_verification.conclusion: Verified identical final head and merge commit source, AST-extracted JSON owner class execution, zero umask calls, fchmod on open fd before durability fsync, atomic replace, and directory fsync.
